title: Minimum Depth of Binary Tree
statement: Return the number of nodes on the shortest path from the root down to a LEAF. An empty tree has depth 0.
hints: The naive mirror of Maximum Depth is wrong: taking min over a missing child returns 0 and reports a fake short path.
A node with only one child must take that child depth, not the minimum with the null side.
Handle the three cases explicitly, or use BFS and return the depth of the first leaf you meet, which is faster on skewed trees.
